# MemWeaver — LLM memory pipeline

## Overview

FastAPI backend + Next.js 16 chat frontend + stdio MCP server implementing a dual-LLM memory pipeline. Ingest Q/A pairs, search via FTS5 + vector embeddings, and chat with wiki-memory augmented LLM.

- **Public chat**: DeepSeek (SSE streaming) with wiki context injection
- **Ingest pipeline**: Ollama-powered distillation, wiki compilation, FTS5 indexing, semantic embeddings
- **Search**: Keyword (FTS5 BM25), semantic (sqlite-vec cosine), hybrid (Reciprocal Rank Fusion)
- **MCP server**: IDE integration (Cursor/Claude Code/OpenCode) with `wiki_search`, `wiki_ingest`, `wiki_get_page`, `wiki_stats` tools

## Key features since v0.1.0

- Two-tier LLM architecture (DeepSeek for chat, Ollama for pipeline)
- Opt-in save-to-memory (chat turns no longer auto-compile)
- Wiki graph endpoint (`GET /wiki/graph`) + D3 force-directed graph widget
- Wiki tree endpoint (`GET /wiki/tree`) for sidebar catalog
- Dashboard UI with three-stage compare view (QA / RAG / LLM-Wiki)
- Wiki sidebar speed improvements
- Sage Garden theme with SVG logo + favicon

## Tech stack

- **Backend**: Python 3.12, FastAPI, aiosqlite, sqlite-vec, httpx, pydantic-settings
- **Frontend**: Next.js 16 (App Router), Tailwind CSS 4, shadcn/ui, react-markdown, D3.js
- **LLM**: DeepSeek (chat), Ollama (pipeline: `qwen2.5:7b-instruct`, `nomic-embed-text`)
- **Storage**: SQLite + FTS5 + sqlite-vec (vector), markdown vault under `wiki/`
- **IDE integration**: stdio MCP server via `server/mcp_server.py`

## Project structure

```
server/main.py           — FastAPI routes: /ingest, /chat, /query, /wiki/*, /health, /stats
server/mcp_server.py     — Stdio MCP server entrypoint
server/models/api.py     — Pydantic schemas (IngestPayload, QueryMode, GraphResponse, etc.)
server/config/settings.py— pydantic-settings (Ollama, DeepSeek, paths)
server/db/               — SQLite init, FTS5 migrations, sqlite-vec extension
server/pipeline/         — Ingest worker, embedder, hybrid search, semantic search
server/services/         — deepseek_client, public_llm, classifier, memory_api, wiki_graph_api, wiki_tree_api, wiki_retriever
chat-app/                — Next.js 16 frontend
  app/page.tsx           — Three-stage dashboard (compare/qa/rag/wiki)
  app/api/chat/route.ts  — SSE proxy to FastAPI
  components/            — ModeChatPanel, SaveToMemory, dashboard/ widgets, ui/
wiki/                    — LLM-wiki markdown vault (index, concepts, log)
raw/                     — Immutable Q/A JSON artifacts
tests/                   — 17 pytest test files
docs/                    — ADRs, specs, plans, roadmap, changelog
```

## API endpoints

| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| POST | `/chat` | Streaming chat via DeepSeek with wiki context (opt-in save) |
| POST | `/ingest` | Enqueue Q/A for async Ollama compilation |
| GET | `/query` | Keyword / semantic / hybrid search |
| GET | `/wiki/{slug}` | Fetch wiki page by slug |
| GET | `/wiki/graph` | Wiki pages as nodes + wikilink edges |
| GET | `/wiki/tree` | Sidebar catalog from wiki/index.md |
| GET | `/health` | Service health + Ollama reachability + DB status |
| GET | `/stats` | Aggregate counters |

## Quick start

```bash
python3 -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
cp .env.example .env   # set DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
uvicorn server.main:app --reload     # terminal 1
cd chat-app && pnpm dev              # terminal 2
```

Requires: Python 3.12+, Node.js 20+, pnpm, Ollama running locally.

## Tests

```bash
./venv/bin/pytest tests/ -v
```
